svg.aria-label: Master board gait pipeline block diagram with future lidar and camera inputs

text.tspan: Thread 1 — Control (100 Hz): the entire center “Gait pipeline” container, plus the per-leg watchdog and safety-gate logic:
- system + gait FSM → per-leg phase → foot trajectory → inverse kinematics → safety gate → pack setpoints → UDP sendto ×4 · status line
- also from the right column: per-leg watchdog and state estimator — in the code these run inside the control thread’s tick, not in their own thread
Thread 2 — RX: from the right column:

svg.text: Master board — how the dog walks

g.text: speed · turn · enable · ack fault · E-stop

svg.text: Future sensors — planned, not in code yet
walking must work with zero sensors:
perception only adjusts speed, heading and
foothold choice — it never drives joints directly

g.text: boot → idle → standup → stand → trot · fault
stance ↔ swing, diagonal pairs in trot
stance: push back · swing: arc forward
foot (x, y, z) → tilt, hip, knee angles
IMU hook (no driver yet) · VO later
no driver yet · tilt fault ready
Ethernet switch · 192.168.1.0/24 · master .1 → legs .11–.14 :5005 · telemetry → master :5006
filled = stance (foot down, pushes body) · empty = swing
